claims: /design is 'the best upgrade Claude Code has gotten in a long time'
Skill stacking: /design plus Impeccable or Taste or any front-end skill in the same prompt
Tweaks section turns any parameter (background color, font size) into a slider via a prompt
Apply the inspiration -> skills -> iterate cycle at component level, not just page level
how_to_steps: Collect reference screenshots of the aesthetic (Pinterest, Dribbble, Landbook, Twitter) and feed them to Claude Code
Run /design and in the same instruction invoke Impeccable (or Taste) so the design skill and the design-system skill stack
Ask for several versions of the page/poster
In the artboard, click a component to open the properties panel; use Tweaks to prompt sliders for background color, font size, etc.
Repeat inspiration -> skills -> iterate per component, then have Claude implement the chosen artboard

Impeccable README: 'Why Impeccable? Anthropic's frontend-design was the first widely-used design skill for Claude... Every model trained on the same SaaS templates... purple-to-blue gradients, cards nested in cards, gray text on colored backgrounds, rounded-square icon tile above every heading. Impeccable adds: One setup flow (/impeccable init writes PRODUCT.md and offers DESIGN.md), 23 commands (polish, audit, critique, quieter...), 59 deterministic detector rules plus LLM-only critique checks. The CLI and browser extension work without an LLM or API key.' Quick start: `npx impeccable install` then `/impeccable <command> <target>`; Apache-2.0
Artboard demo 'The Rhythm Section - Set payday once. It loops forever.' with color swatch rows and a pricing card '[$X] / person / month'
Properties panel: Appearance Background #212225, Radius 0, Overflow visible, Opacity 1.00; Sizing Width 247px Height 128px; Position
